book.singleDesc:
Embark on a solo journey through our immersive stories. Make choices, face challenges, and shape your own destiny in a world of endless possibilities.

Multiplayer mode coming soon!
book.multiplayerDesc: Join forces with friends or compete against others in thrilling multiplayer adventures. Collaborate, strategize, and experience the excitement of shared storytelling.
book.guestDesc:
Play as a guest and dive into our captivating stories without the need for an account. Experience the thrill of adventure with just a click.

Login coming soon for a personalized experience!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

terms.body: By accessing Paths Games you agree to the following terms. All game content, stories, artwork and code are the intellectual property of Paths Games unless otherwise stated. You agree not to misuse the service or attempt unauthorised access. The game is provided as-is during the development phase.
